d: Green and yellow balloons at Old Trafford were not there to celebrate Manchester United. They were a protest against the club's ownership, with supporters demanding that the Glazers and Sir Jim Ratcliffe sell up. From opposition to the proposed new Old Trafford stadium to United's alarming position near the bottom of the Premier League table, the anger runs much deeper than a few poor results. With questions over recruitment, leadership and the club's direction, Rupha Ramani examines Manchester United's ownership crisis, the growing fan revolt and how one of football's biggest institutions…
